stories.title: Baez hits 3 straight HRs in 'crazy,' historic debut
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie outfielder Joshua Baez set an MLB record with three home runs in the first three plate appearances of his major league career.

stories.title: McVay: No 'invisible deadline' on Donald decision
stories.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay says he won't put an "invisible deadline" on Aaron Donald to come out of retirement but added that he hopes the former star defensive tackle makes a decision "sooner than later."

stories.title: Pirates skip Skenes start to rest struggling ace
stories.summary: The Pirates will move Paul Skenes' next scheduled start back three days, giving the struggling ace extra rest amid the worst stretch of his major league career.

stories.title: Pallister stuns Ledecky with first int'l 800m loss
stories.summary: Lani Pallister of Australia stunned Katie Ledecky with her first international loss in the 800-meter freestyle at the Pan Pacific Championships.

stories.title: Shields reclaims middleweight titles by brutal TKO
stories.summary: Claressa Shields looked as sharp as ever despite dropping three weight classes, dominating Kaye Scott by sixth-round TKO to reclaim the WBC and WBA middleweight titles.
